summary: The filing is an 8-K by RRE Ventures Acquisition Corp., a blank-check SPAC, announcing that holders of its units may elect to separately trade the underlying Class A ordinary shares and warrants starting May 20, 2026. The units were issued in its May 1, 2026 IPO of 25 million units, and underwriters forfeited their over-allotment option on May 14, 2026. This is a routine administrative step after a SPAC IPO, not a special situation event. There are no deal terms, activist campaigns, or strategic changes involved.
